ingredients.name: strawberries or other berries, to top

steps.title: Make the crust
steps.text: Mix the graham cracker crumbs, melted butter and sugar until it looks like wet sand. Press it firmly into the base of a 20 cm springform pan with the bottom of a glass, then chill.

steps.title: Beat the cream cheese
steps.text: In the stand mixer with the paddle attachment, beat the cream cheese, powdered sugar, lemon juice, vanilla and salt on medium until completely smooth with no lumps. Scrape down the bowl once.

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.text: In a clean bowl, whip the cold cream to stiff peaks. They should stand straight up when you lift the whisk.

steps.title: Fold together
steps.text: Fold the whipped cream into the cream cheese in three additions, gently, until no streaks remain. Overmixing deflates it.

steps.title: Fill and chill
steps.text: Spread the filling over the crust, smooth the top, cover and chill until firmly set. Overnight is best.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Run a thin knife around the edge, release the springform and slice with a hot, clean knife. Top with berries.

steps.title: Chop the chocolate
steps.text: Chop the chocolate as finely as you can and put it in a heatproof bowl with the salt. Small pieces melt evenly.

steps.title: Make the ganache
steps.text: Heat the cream and butter in a saucepan until steaming at the edges, not boiling. Pour over the chocolate, wait 2 minutes, then stir slowly from the center outward until smooth and glossy. Stir in the vanilla.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover and chill until firm enough to scoop but not rock hard.

steps.title: Scoop and roll
steps.text: Scoop about 15 g (a heaped teaspoon) at a time and roll quickly between your palms into balls. If your hands warm the ganache too much, dust them with cocoa or chill the bowl again.

steps.title: Coat and set
steps.text: Roll each ball in cocoa powder. Chill 20 minutes to firm up, and serve slightly cool.

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.text: In the stand mixer with the whisk attachment, whip the cold cream with the powdered sugar and vanilla to medium-stiff peaks. It should hold its shape when spread.

steps.title: Line the pan
steps.text: Line a 23 x 13 cm loaf pan with plastic wrap, leaving plenty hanging over the sides.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread a thin layer of cream on the bottom, then cover with graham crackers, breaking them to fit. Add about a quarter of the cream, then more crackers. Repeat to make 4 layers of crackers, finishing with cream.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Fold the plastic wrap over the top and chill until the crackers have softened into a cake-like texture.

steps.title: Unmold and serve
steps.text: Pull the cake out using the plastic wrap, top with shaved chocolate and slice with a sharp knife.

ingredients.name: strawberries or raspberries, for the sauce

steps.title: Bloom the gelatin
steps.text: Sprinkle the gelatin over the cold water in a small bowl and leave it to soak until it looks spongy.

steps.title: Warm the cream
steps.text: Heat the cream, milk, sugar and vanilla in a saucepan, stirring, until the sugar dissolves and steam rises. Do not let it boil.

steps.title: Dissolve the gelatin
steps.text: Take the pan off the heat and whisk in the bloomed gelatin until no grains remain. Pour through a sieve into a jug.

steps.title: Pour and set
steps.text: Divide among 6 lightly oiled ramekins or glasses. Cool on the counter for 20 minutes, then cover and chill until set but still wobbly.

steps.title: Make the berry sauce
steps.text: Simmer the berries with the sugar for a few minutes until juicy and slightly thick. Cool.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve in the glasses, or dip each ramekin in hot water for 10 seconds and turn out onto a plate. Spoon the sauce over the top.

steps.title: Prep the pan
steps.text: Line a 23 cm square pan with parchment and lightly grease the parchment. Measure the cereal into a very large bowl.

steps.title: Melt the butter
steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pot over low heat until foamy.

steps.title: Melt the marshmallows
steps.text: Add the marshmallows and stir constantly until completely melted and smooth. Take off the heat and stir in the vanilla and salt.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Add the cereal and fold quickly with a greased spatula until every piece is coated.

steps.title: Press and cool
steps.text: Tip into the pan and press down lightly with a greased spatula. Packing too hard makes them tough. Cool before cutting into 16 squares.

steps.title: Heat-treat the flour
steps.text: Raw flour can carry bacteria, so heat it first. Spread the flour in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave in 30-second bursts, stirring each time, until a thermometer reads 74 °C. Cool completely, then sift to remove lumps.

steps.title: Cream the butter and sugars
steps.text: In the stand mixer with the paddle attachment, cream the butter with both sugars until pale and fluffy.

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.text: Mix in the milk, vanilla and salt. Add the cooled flour on low speed until just combined, then stir in the chocolate chips.

steps.title: Scoop and chill
steps.text: Scoop about 20 g at a time, roll smooth and set on a parchment-lined tray. Chill until firm.

steps.title: Dip
steps.text: Melt the dipping chocolate gently in the microwave in 20-second bursts, stirring between each. Dip each ball with a fork, tap off the excess and return to the tray. Chill until the coating sets.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.text: Line two trays with parchment. Measure the oats, peanut butter and vanilla and keep them next to the stove, because the next steps move fast.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar, butter, milk, cocoa and salt. Bring to a full rolling boil over medium heat, stirring, then boil for exactly 1 minute. Too short and they stay soft, too long and they turn crumbly.

steps.title: Stir in
steps.text: Off the heat, stir in the peanut butter and vanilla until smooth, then fold in the oats until evenly coated.

steps.title: Scoop and set
steps.text: Drop heaped spoonfuls onto the trays and leave at room temperature until firm.

steps.title: Melt the chocolate
steps.text: Heat the 100 g of cream until steaming and pour over the chopped chocolate. Wait 1 minute, then stir until smooth. Stir in the vanilla and salt.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Let the chocolate cool until barely warm but still pourable. If it is hot it will melt the cream, and if it sets it will form lumps.

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.text: With the stand mixer's whisk attachment, whip the cold cream and sugar to soft peaks. They should droop slightly when you lift the whisk.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Stir a third of the whipped cream into the chocolate to loosen it. Then fold in the rest gently with a spatula until no streaks remain.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Spoon into 6 glasses and chill until set. Top with shaved chocolate or a little whipped cream.
